استقطبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَبُوا (istaqṭabū) /is.taq.tˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# اُسْتُقْطِبُوا (ustuqṭibū) /us.tuq.tˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
# اِسْتَقْطِبُوا (istaqṭibū) /is.taq.tˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْطَبَ (istaqṭaba)
